title: Resident First-Return Courtesy on Respite Stay Returned-Payment Fees
content:
Larkspur independent living residents with a clean payment record on their independent living account receive a courtesy on the returned-payment fee of a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

**Courtesy.** The resident first-return courtesy is fifty percent (50 percent) for a guest with an active Larkspur independent living residency whose independent living account shows no returned payment posted in the last twelve months (12 months), twenty-five percent (25 percent) for a guest with an active Larkspur independent living residency whose account shows exactly one returned payment posted in the last twelve months, and nothing for any other guest.

**What it reduces.** The courtesy is taken on the statutory service charge of the returned payment — the service charge for the returned item itself — as it stands, and on nothing else in the fee: the service charge is multiplied by 50 percent at a 50 percent courtesy and by 75 percent at a 25 percent courtesy.

**Records read.** The guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status, and the returned-payment entries posted on that independent living account in the last twelve months. Returned payments on the respite stay itself are not part of that count.

## Courtesy table

| Active Independent Living Residency Agreement | Returned payments on the independent living account in the last 12 months | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| Held | None | 50 percent |
| Held | Exactly one | 25 percent |
| Held | Two or more | Nothing |
| Not held | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations (service charge of 30.00)

- Active resident, no return on the independent living account in the last 12 months: 30.00 times 50 percent, that is 15.00.
- Active resident with one such return: 30.00 times 75 percent, that is 22.50.
- Guest without an active residency: 30.00, no courtesy.
